name: pocketappstcg
description: Shared public version, licensing and provider policy for the PocketApps TCG family

scripts.validate:head: node scripts/validate.mjs --no-download
scripts.worker:dev: npm run build:worker && npx wrangler dev -c conditioning-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run build:worker && npx wrangler deploy -c conditioning-worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.worker:secret: npx wrangler secret put DEEPSEEK_KEY -c conditioning-worker/wrangler.toml
